name: manual_180e96
claim: Before closing a stale/superseded PR as 'nothing to salvage', check its .agent/memory/candidates/graduated/*.json files individually (git show <branch>:<path> for each), not just its code diff. A superseded code change can still carry a graduated memory lesson recording a claim (e.g. 'skill X wrapper exists at path Y') that is factually false on current main — revealing a real gap worth fixing even when the rest of the PR is dead weight.

decisions.notes: PR #202's audit_attribution.sh changes were fully superseded by main, but one of its two graduated memory JSON files claimed the agent-coordination-heartbeat PT wrapper already existed at .agents/skills/agent-coordination-heartbeat/SKILL.md. It didn't. Checking the memory files (not just the code diff) is what surfaced that gap, which became PR #206.
